status: Conditional scratch-only diagnostic; no tracked application, build, tests or runtime by this author
experiment: Same binary: trial control first. Only a valid reproduced failure with expected attachment/lifetimes permits the detach arm. Both arms set HANGTEN_REVIEW_BOARD_DETACH_TRIAL=1 and existing diagnostic/census flags; only action arm sets HANGTEN_REVIEW_DETACH_DISAPPEARING_BOARD_HOST=1. No Train suppression or other inherited host experiments.
commonChanges: Exact Evo one-presentation main Train card gets DEBUG environment marker; no BoardMap edit, geometry/layout alteration or suppression. Workout and other cards remain unmarked.

Weak attachment ownership record after both content.add calls, keyed scene/view UUID, with fresh owner UUID per record. Record binds only when both entities share a nonnil parent and actual RealityKit Scene. Attachment may be pending immediately after add; existing capture observes later without a new poll.

Registry intentionally retains already-created BoardModelRealityScene/model/entities/resource lease in both arms until process termination. No strong parent or RealityKit Scene property. Diagnostic retention must be removed before any production candidate.

All original make and update callbacks run unchanged, including applySync after disappear. A repeated make invalidates detachment eligibility after its normal content.add calls; it is not blocked. No ordinary callback is suppressed.
Existing capture serializes owner/attachment/action fields only after update dedup. No new timer, body logging, observable state, counter, task, sampler or material/camera mutation.
detachGuard: Explicit Train marker true; Evo one-presentation launch source gate
Initial shared nonnil parent/actual scene observed; weak references still live
No invalidation or change in attachment
Exact scene model identity and current-owner UUID still match
Both current root/camera parents and scenes are identical to recorded weak ownership
action: Synchronously remove only scene.root and scene.camera from their parents. Never remove or disable the shared parent or mutate workout entities. Record sparse before/after captures in both arms. Verify both parent and scene references become nil; otherwise action is invalid. No await between ownership guard and removal.
staleCallbackSafety: A new make with another view key replaces current-owner UUID for that scene, so old disappear cannot detach its entities.
Repeated make with the same key runs normally then invalidates that record and replaces its owner UUID, preventing a late stale detach.
Late update callbacks continue original applySync. Later census records reattachedAfterDetach if external reattachment occurs; such a run is invalid, with no forced second removal.
requiredRuntimeGates: Source/input/installed code parity and exact launch environment for both arms
Train renders normally before leaving; its marker is true, workout marker false
Opening-to-tail complete constructor stream and weak census
Control keeps predecessor model/lease and same attachment through workout; must reproduce stale-color failure under trial common changes
Action targets exactly the marked predecessor, with observed ownership before and nil parent+scene afterward
Predecessor wrapper/root/camera remain alive through all action captures; their resource lease owner remains the same retained model
Workout identities, actual frame, camera, selections, natural timing and all CPU/image brackets unchanged
No repeated make, stale owner action, unexpected constructor, unobserved ownership, detach failure or later reattachment
Terminate the owned diagnostic app at end to release intentional retained models

limits: No generic teardown/reappearance design; repeated host makes run normally but invalidate this one-way diagnostic.
Holding models changes lifetime versus production; shared control reproduction is mandatory.
CPU attachment and nil membership do not prove GPU host destruction, scheduler behavior or causality.
Same shared-parent assumption is deliberately narrower than general RealityView ownership; observed case only.
Apply-check verifies textual applicability only, not Swift typechecking. No test is claimed executed.
apiContext: Uses removeFromParent according to retained predecessor-attachment-proposal/apple-api-notes.md; no private renderer API.
reviewRevision: Parent requested removal of all callback skipping. Earlier draft/report/provenance retained as *.before-callback-review. Final patch preserves normal make/update behavior; only marked guarded disappear action detaches.
